notes: ACCESS: Direct HTTP (curl) to argos.co.uk was blocked by an Akamai edge 'Access Denied' response, and WebFetch got HTTP 403 on the same host — tier 1 failed, escalated per hard-block rule. Tier 2 (a dedicated Playwright/CDP tool) was not available in this session, so proceeded to tier 3, Claude-in-Chrome, as last resort. robots.txt (fetched via Chrome, since direct curl was blocked at the edge) has no Claude-specific disallow and no site-wide Disallow: / for any UA (only /wishlist, /list/*, /checkout/, /confirmation/ blocked for standard bots) — cleared for browser automation. DISCOVERY: Argos organizes seasonal categories under a 'Gifts and occasions' taxonomy branch (also mirrored under home-and-furniture > home-furnishings for some nodes). CHRISTMAS: canonical root 'Christmas decorations' (https://www.argos.co.uk/browse/gifts-and-occasions/christmas-decorations/c:1055238/, 751 products) expands via its own Category filter into 10 confirmed leaf PLPs (christmas trees, lights, tree decorations, table & room decorations, wreaths & garlands, outdoor decorations, advent calendars, crackers, baubles, wrapping), each independently visited and its own displayed 'N products' count recorded (all matched the parent filter's facet counts exactly). An 11th leaf, 'Christmas tree skirts and stands' (c:797716, 17 products), is cross-filed under the home-and-furniture/home-furnishings path but is linked directly from the Christmas decorations carousel/related-categories and is a genuine PLP — included. Two additional labels, 'Christmas stockings' and 'Christmas candles and home fragrance', appeared repeatedly in related-category widgets and in the /search/christmas-decorations/ page's category facet (counts 11-15 and ~14 respectively there), but a direct check of /search/christmas-stockings/ resolved only to a generic keyword search results page (not a canonical /browse/.../c:NNNNNN/ category URL), so a genuine dedicated taxonomy URL could not be confirmed within this session before the shared Chrome instance's tab group was repeatedly reset by other concurrent workers — EXCLUDED from rows per the no-fabrication rule; flagged here for a follow-up spot check rather than guessed. Children counts sum to more than the 751 parent total because products are cross-tagged into multiple sub-categories (e.g. a bauble can appear in both 'Christmas baubles' and 'Christmas table and room decorations') — normal overlap, not an error; parent recorded as a grouping row per the shared grouping rule. HALLOWEEN: single confirmed category 'Halloween decorations' (https://www.argos.co.uk/browse/gifts-and-occasions/halloween-decorations/c:1043402/, 94 products, own page title 'Halloween decorations: props, lights and reusable décor'). Its on-page carousel (Autumnal decorations, Hosting & parties, Halloween clothing, Halloween characters, LEGO) links to /list/ curated marketing pages rather than further /browse/ category nodes, so no further Halloween sub-categories were recorded. EASTER and VALENTINE'S DAY: found only as genuine Occasion-facet PLPs inside the generic 'Party decorations and supplies' category (c:29186, 52 products total, non-seasonal itself so not recorded as a row) — 'Easter Party decorations and supplies' (occasion:easter/, 18 products, own page title) and 'Valentines Party decorations and supplies' (occasion:valentines/, 3 products, own page title) both content-verified as real filtered PLPs with their own titles/URLs/counts, not just search noise. CONTENT-VERIFIED AND EXCLUDED per the rule that Mother's/Father's Day are in-scope events but must be content-verified, not included on name alone: 'Mother's Day gifts' (/events/mothers-day-gifts) is a pure editorial gift-guide landing page (history, tips, generic sub-links to Clothing/Tech/Jewellery — no Mother's-Day-specific product count) — excluded as marketing/editorial, not a PLP. 'Father's Day' search redirects to /list/fathers-day-shop-all-gifts/ (1217 products) which is a generic cross-department 'gifts for dad' curated list (BBQ tools, watches, footballs, shavers, LEGO — ordinary general merchandise, not Father's-Day-specific items) — excluded, fails the genuine-seasonal-product-type test. CHECKED AND ABSENT (real investigation, not assumed): Diwali — /events/diwali-gifting 404s, no category exists. New Year decorations — /search/new-year-decorations/ returns non-discriminating default results (PAW Patrol toys, Spider-Man figures, LEGO sets unrelated to New Year) confirming no dedicated category, classic false-absence-search pattern correctly identified rather than trusted. Thanksgiving/Eid/Diwali sub-festivals were not separately re-tested beyond the Diwali check given Argos is a UK-only general retailer with no other festival taxonomy signal anywhere in the site navigation encountered. All qty figures are the exact 'N products' header displayed on each category's own canonical PLP (priority-1 method), independently re-verified by visiting each leaf URL directly rather than trusting only the parent's facet counts.
